parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (a UUID) per logical submit, 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters. A retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and changes nothing; the same key with another method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. Keys are global and kept 24 hours.
